title: Harassment, stalking or indecent behaviour towards a woman
triggers: someone touched me inappropriately on the bus
mujhe koi pareshan kar raha hai

rights.plain_explanation: Assaulting or using force on a woman intending to outrage her modesty is a crime, with at least one year in prison.
Sexual harassment, including unwelcome physical contact, demands for sexual favours and showing pornography, is a crime.
Repeatedly following or contacting a woman, or monitoring her online, despite her clear disinterest, is stalking.
Words, sounds, gestures or showing objects meant to insult a woman's modesty are a crime.
You can file the FIR at any police station (Zero FIR) or by electronic means.

do_now: If you're in danger now, move to a safe, public place and call 112.
Save evidence: screenshots, messages, call logs, names of witnesses.
File a complaint at the nearest police station; it doesn't have to be the local one.

escalation.label: Online harassment
escalation.detail: Report on the National Cybercrime Reporting Portal.

escalation.label: Free legal aid
escalation.detail: Call NALSA on 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) at the district court. Women, children, people in custody and people below the income limit get a free lawyer.
